verdict.rationale: Notion markets an integrated search/AI answer experience ('Get answers, instantly—with citations' and 'bring everything into one system of record'), but a hands-on user comment explicitly states 'search still needs love' when discussing Notion's workflow, directly contradicting the fast/accurate claim. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of search speed/accuracy across tasks, docs, and comments, and more recent evidence resolving the community complaint.
